description: WorldFloods v2 is the ML4Floods research team's satellite-image benchmark for flood segmentation. The provider publishes 509 Sentinel-2 image and mask pairs divided into training, validation and test sets. Coverage consists of selected flood scenes, not a continuous global observation record; exact dates and footprints follow individual images. The public Hugging Face dataset is free for permitted noncommercial reuse under CC-BY-NC-4.0, with linked notebooks for exploring the files and constructing PyTorch data loaders. A limitation is that cloud cover and annotation methods affect segmentation labels, and a published benchmark split does not establish transfer to every flood region. The provider card does not state a single acquisition period or uniform output resolution. WorldFloods v2 can train flood mapping and supply comparison evidence for infrastructure inundation simulations such as Delft3D FM (model-delft3d-fm). The Scientific Reports 2023 paper describes the dataset and method. No images, masks or model weights were downloaded.
